notes.title: Legend of Hand - new patch
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've just uploaded a small patch to Steam which fixes the following issues:

[i]- several occasions where the inventory bar disappeared and wouldn't come back.[/i]

If you were effected by this bug, just update the game and reload your most recent save. You should now be able to progress.

Old save files should not be broken by this update.

Many thanks,
Shaun
[b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b]

notes.title: Bug fixes - new update
notes.content:
I've released a small update which should finally address some ongoing issues with the main character sometimes getting stuck in place in a particular spot late in the game.

Also fixed a couple of spelling errors.

Existing saved game files should load as normal and shouldn't be effected by the update.

Thanks for your support,
Shaun
[i]Cloak and Dagger Games[/i]

notes.title: Our new game is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Our new game, Football Game, is OUT NOW! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/654550/Football_Game/

[b]Story[/b]
East Bend, Purchase County. 1987.
You are Tommy, a local high school football hero in the town of East Bend. It’s game night for the Purchase County Turbines and your sweetheart is waiting in the bleachers. Join Tommy for a night you won’t forget...

Something is amiss...

[b]Features[/b]
- A traditional point and click adventure game aesthetic with puzzles and dialogue interactions familiar to the genre.
- A cast of characters including friends, foes, teachers, and a concerned mother.
- A short, twisted narrative with approximately 45 minutes to an hour of gameplay, depending on the player.
- Original soundtrack by UK duo JUPITER-C, which will also be available on cassette.

[b]Inspiration?[/b]
Traditional point and click adventure games from the '80s and '90s, the music and films of David Lynch, the uncanny.

notes.title: Legend of Hand - tiny update released
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Just updated the game, as some people were experiencing issues with the game not running correctly in full-screen. This was due to an issue with default resolution settings which should now be fixed.

Also fixed a bug where the hero could get stuck in place on Green Island.

Thanks for playing!
Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games

notes.title: Legend of Hand Update 1.03
notes.content:
Hey guys, 

I've just done a little update which fixes the following bugs:

- The issue with not being able to click on the snake drawing in the sand when you should be able to, on Island 3.
- The issue with the player character getting stuck and not being able to walk in a specific place on Island 4.
- A few little minor fixes here and there, like the bit where you could click on the hand during the fish tickling game on Island 2.

Big thanks to whiteblack for finding the snake drawing bug, that was a potential game-killer!

Thank you for your support, we hope you are enjoying the game!

Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games
